cards.title: Guruhchaning umumiy belgisi
cards.body: N, P, As, Sb, Bi: tashqi qavat5, s2p3. Asosiy holatni ajrating.

cards.title: Jadvaldan aniq ma’lumot o‘qish
cards.body: N7/14/2; P15/31/3; As33/75/4; Sb51/122/5; Bi83/209/6 — tartib raqami, massa, qavat soni.

cards.title: N va P elektronlari
cards.body: N:1s2 2s2 2p3. P:1s2 2s2 2p6 3s2 3p3. Jami elektron va tashqi qavatni alohida sanang.

cards.title: N2 bog‘lanishi
cards.body: Ikki atom va uchta umumiy juft: qutbsiz kovalent N≡N modeli.

cards.title: Hajm ulushi va massa ulushi
cards.body: Havodagi78% hajmiy va75,5% massaviy azot bir xil ulush emas. NaNO3, nitratlar va oqsillar birikma misollari.

cards.title: Havodan ajratish g‘oyasi
cards.body: Qaynash nuqtalari farqi ajratish bilan bog‘langan. Sxema mazmunini tushuntiring.

cards.title: Faollik sharoitga bog‘liq
cards.body: Rangsiz va hidsiz N2; odatdagi sharoitda faolligi past. Bu mutlaq reaksiyasizlik emas.

cards.title: Kislorod va vodorod misollari
cards.body: N2+O2=2NO−Q; N2+3H2=2NH3+Q. Har bir berilgan modelning shartini saqlang.

cards.title: Nitrid formulalari
cards.body: Li3N va Mg3N2 formulalarini berilgan tenglamalardan o‘qing.

cards.title: Ishlangan zichlik misoli
cards.body: Berilgan: M28, Vm22,4(n.sh.). Formula: rho=M/Vm. Hisob:28/22,4=1,25g/L. Tekshiruv: vodorodga nisbatan28/2=14.

examples.title: N2 ning normal sharoit modeli
examples.body: Berilgan M28g/mol va Vm22,4L/mol. rho=M/Vm=1,25g/L; birlik(g/mol)/(L/mol)=g/L. D(H2)=28/2=14, nisbiy kattalik.
